children: Thomson Reuters (TRI) posted Q3 revenue of $1.83 billion and adjusted EPS of $0.81. It raised 2026 organic revenue growth guidance to 8.5%–9.0%, with about 9.5% total revenue growth.

Thomson Reuters raised about $2.0 billion by issuing U.S.- and Canadian-dollar notes in September, using proceeds for general corporate needs, including repaying commercial paper.
